text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin achieved magnificent results
in the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those
truly precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Ines Fujin in first place!
A magnificent first-place finish across the line!!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...So nostalgic.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we've run in
so many different races, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So, looking back at my past races,
I noticed that at some point,
I stopped collapsing right after finishing as often!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I thought pacing myself had become second nature to my body, but... when it comes to having any stamina left after the race, well...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Kind of like, 'hmm'—you know...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe the power of their cheers?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Just like during the Derby, the moment I heard someone's voice, I felt a tiny bit of strength return to my legs.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So in order to keep earning everyone's support—
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's the manager. Excuse me for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yes, hello—oh.
I saw next week's shift schedule!
Got it, thanks so much!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Oops. Trainer.
Is it alright if we go over next week's schedule now?

This exchange had become second nature.
I open my schedule book and prepare to take notes.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's a huge help!
All praise to the Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right. Whenever I'm not working my part-time job,
I'm gonna pack in more and more training!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So that people will continue to support me—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: All I can do is give it my absolute best!
